experimental_unit: one fixed freshstack query evaluated on each chunker's index

controlled_variables.retrieval: hybrid (BM25 + dense, RRF k=60), rerank disabled, top_k 50

validity_gates.basis: baseline hybrid__raw mean R@5 = 0.255884 minus the paired bootstrap 95% half-width 0.024838 (gate_noise.json paired_reference.recall_at_5.ci95_halfwidth); 0.255884 - 0.024838 = 0.231046, non-inferiority floor

baseline 0.278862 minus paired bootstrap 95% half-width 0.020571 (gate_noise.json paired_reference.recall_at_10); most at-risk workload: heading-prefix tokens and identifier splitting damage exact-token recall

baseline token total recomputed at run time with the same tokenizer counter over the exp 22 corpus manifest and recorded in the runtime manifest before the candidate build; 15% headroom covers chunk-boundary redistribution

additional.basis: 1.5 x baseline p95 1984.2 ms; clears the baseline p95 estimator CI upper bound 2334.3 ms (gate_noise.json)

monitored_non_gating.reason: bootstrap 95% half-width is 0.15 at n=20 (gate_noise.json categories.continuity); any hard gate would be noise, so continuity is recorded and inspected, not gated
